release_notes:
Third public beta of HuashijieLibre for 画世界Pro v3.4.6 (build 313).

### What's changed
- Hid the Cloud tab in the photo picker when the canvas cloud toggle is enabled, aligned picker tabs with the Done action across single- and multi-select flows, and expanded narrow rounded finish buttons so translated labels fit on one line.
- Equalized card heights in the left canvas tool grid to remove staggered gaps, fixed boundary line-wrap oscillation on toolbar labels, and hid the Account & Security entry when the offline profile is active.
- Added a Contribute translations entry in HuashijieLibre settings linking to TRANSLATING.md, revised Vietnamese and English settings and patch descriptions, and restored 画世界Pro naming consistency in the English dictionary.
- Added community translation tooling and guides (TRANSLATING.md, GLOSSARY.md, shared Gradle and CI dictionary validation, and CLI helpers for initializing, syncing, and flattening language packs).
- Replaced hardcoded obfuscated reflection across all extension classes with structural bytecode resolution backed by 119 target parity checks, and moved libPaintLib.so patching to an ELF32/ELF64 masked AOB resolver while preserving original DEX method budgets.

### Notes
- Compatible with unmodified 画世界Pro (net.huanci.hsjpro) v3.4.6 (versionCode 313), SHA-256 1d5bfdcc32d9a593c3f34bc83c3af300ac19e691082b620bd89cfb46fc7271aa for user verification. This release provides .mpp patch files only and does not include any APK.
- Patch with patches-1.0.0-beta.3.mpp in Morphe Manager or morphe-cli. Back up your Morphe keystore and /sdcard/HuashijiePro/Draft/ before updating.
- If you previously placed override dictionaries in /sdcard/HuashijiePro/lang/, remove older files so the app loads the updated bundled translations.
